paper_title: Neutron Stars with Exceptionally Light QCD Axions
notes: Exceptionally light QCD axion constrained by neutron-star observables. Headline = Fig.18 left (Combined constraint), pink Scenario A (K_sigma=0), which the paper explicitly designates as the conservative benchmark. The excluded region is a diagonal BAND in the (m_a,1/f_a) plane, not a single curve: the paper excludes epsilon=(m_a/m_a^QCD)^2 in [5e-7, 0.2] for m_a >~ 2e-9 eV (abstract; Tables IV/V/VII combined Scenario A give union [5.2e-7,0.17] from NS cooling+crust relaxation+glitches). Converted to canonical plane via 1/f_a = m_a[eV]/(sqrt(epsilon)*5.7e6 GeV) using m_a^QCD=5.7ueV*(1e12GeV/f_a). data_points trace the closed boundary polygon: lower edge (epsilon=0.2, closest to QCD line) left->right at 1/f_a=3.92e-7*m_a, then upper edge (epsilon=5e-7) right->left at 1/f_a=2.48e-4*m_a. There is a gap between the band lower edge and the QCD line (0.2<epsilon<1 not excluded). Reconstruction cross-checked against rasterized Fig.18 (constraint_combined_new.pdf). No stated CL (theoretical/observational estimate); dm_density not applicable. Scenarios B,C (K_sigma=0.08,0.16) give stronger bounds toward QCD line but Scenario A is the reported conservative headline.
